hypothesis: F2-WP-302 currently accepts a caller-constructed RetrievalResult as familiarity evidence without binding it to an exact F2-WP-301 RetrievalPlan/need identity or an upstream-issued result digest. Because RetrievalResult itself has no construction-time invariant validation, a caller can set selected=true and an arbitrary weighted_score_bp while bypassing WP-301 multi-axis selection/provenance semantics, thereby inflating familiarity/attention as if accepted retrieval evidence existed.
counterhypothesis: All production callers are permanently guaranteed to pass only RetrievalResult objects returned by build_retrieval_plan, so an explicit cross-component provenance fence is unnecessary.

missing_cross_component_fences: no expected result digest supplied by upstream plan
no validation that selected/classification follows WP-301 overlap policy
no validation that lifecycle/classification/payload/provenance fields are mutually consistent with a WP-301 result
source_observation.consumer_effect: evaluate() sets familiarity_bp to max(weighted_score_bp) over accepted inputs and attention_priority_bp may therefore be caller-inflated even when no genuine WP-301 plan selected that memory. With no residual the epistemic status remains UNKNOWN, so this does not directly mint a fact/effect/completion, but it breaks retrieval-evidence provenance and can bias downstream attention.

minimal_counterexample.construction: Directly instantiate a RetrievalResult with selected=true, weighted_score_bp=10000, syntactically valid SHA-256 fields, but overlap_count=0/empty overlap axes and no provenance from build_retrieval_plan; pass it to FamiliarityPredictionBinding.evaluate(residual=None).
minimal_counterexample.expected_fail_closed_behavior: Reject because selected familiarity evidence cannot be proven to come from an exact admitted WP-301 retrieval plan/result identity.
minimal_counterexample.current_source_prediction: The current validator accepts the object if its small checked field subset is syntactically valid, then emits familiarity_bp=10000 and attention_priority_bp=10000 with STATUS_UNKNOWN.

test_gap: The current WP-302 test helper creates every RetrievalResult through RetrievalCandidate + RetrievalNeed + build_retrieval_plan. Therefore the test suite does not exercise direct-constructor or cross-plan provenance forgery.
recommended_repair: Prefer accepting an exact RetrievalPlan plus expected plan digest/need identity and derive familiarity inputs only from plan.selected inside the binding.

If result-level input must remain supported, require explicit upstream-issued expected result digests and validate schema/classification/lifecycle/selection/overlap/provenance consistency before scoring.
Add a deterministic regression that directly constructs an internally inconsistent selected RetrievalResult and requires fail-closed rejection.
Preserve FAMILIARITY != OBSERVATION, RETRIEVAL_SCORE != TRUTH, PREDICTION_MATCH != COMPLETION and all existing effect/completion boundaries.
next_exact_action: The canonical F2-WP-302 mutation owner should add the forged-result regression, bind familiarity evidence to exact WP-301 plan/result provenance, run repository-hosted CI, and reconcile only at component scope.
